id: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith (2005)

facts.text: I've cooked for you since you were a boy, Anakin. Sit down and eat something before the council meets.
facts.why: Obi-Wan never cooks for Anakin and never says this. His real line on the quote page is 'I have trained you since you were a small boy.'
facts.fix: I have trained you since you were a small boy.

fix_note.text: I have trained you since you were a small boy.

facts.text: The tragedy of Darth Plagueis, told over drinks.
facts.why: Palpatine tells Anakin the Plagueis story in his box at the opera, and no drinks are mentioned.
facts.fix: The tragedy of Darth Plagueis, told at the opera.

vibe.verdict: The opera night idea is a clever fit and the Plagueis and Order 66 nods land, but the dishes are mostly generic fine dining.
missing: 'Hello there!' and 'So uncivilized' (Obi-Wan vs Grievous on Utapau)
'I have the high ground' on Mustafar
Palpatine's 'Good is a point of view, Anakin'

Mace Windu and the window in the Chancellor's office
